name: Stereo3D
description: Converts between stereoscopic 3D layouts (side by side, above below, interleaved) and anaglyph or checkerboard output at the same frame size, like FFmpeg's stereo3d.

params.name: input
params.description: Input layout: 0 sbsl (side by side, left eye first), 1 sbsr, 2 abl (above below, left eye first), 3 abr, 4 irl (interleaved rows, left eye on even rows), 5 irr, 6 icl (interleaved columns), 7 icr

params.name: output
params.description: Output layout: 0 arcg, 1 arch, 2 arcc, 3 arcd, 4 agmg, 5 agmh, 6 agmc, 7 agmd, 8 aybg, 9 aybh, 10 aybc, 11 aybd, 12 arbg, 13 argg (anaglyphs, FFmpeg names), 14 ml, 15 mr, 16 irl, 17 irr, 18 sbsl, 19 sbsr, 20 abl, 21 abr, 22 chl, 23 chr, 24 icl, 25 icr
